actions.ask_question.description: Asks a question in natural language and returns an answer drawn from your Slite docs, with sources.
actions.ask_question.props.parent_note_i: Limit the answer to docs nested under this parent.
actions.ask_question.props.question.desc: The question to ask your Slite knowledge base.
actions.create_doc.description: Creates a doc inside a parent doc or your private channel.
actions.create_doc.props.attributes.desc: Attributes for the parent collection, ordered by column. Ignored if they don't match the column type.
How the content above is written.
Where to create the new doc. Leave blank to create it in your private channel.
actions.create_doc.props.template_id.des: Apply a template to the new doc by its ID.
actions.create_doc.props.title.descripti: The title of the new doc.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.fetch_doc.description: Returns a readable doc by its ID.
actions.fetch_doc.props.format.descripti: The format to return the doc content in.
actions.fetch_doc.props.note_id.descript: Start typing to search your docs by title.
actions.fetch_sub_docs.description: Returns the list of sub docs nested under a parent doc.
actions.fetch_sub_docs.props.note_id.des: The doc whose sub docs you want to list.
actions.index_askx_object.description: Sends an object to be indexed by AskX for your custom source. Note: Slite has deprecated this endpoint.
actions.index_askx_object.props.object_i: A unique identifier for this object within the source.
The root ID of your custom data source (created in Slite).
actions.index_askx_object.props.type.des: How the content above is written.
actions.index_askx_object.props.updated_: When the object was last modified.
actions.index_askx_object.props.url.desc: The redirect URL for the object.
actions.replace_doc.description: Replaces the entire content and/or title of a doc. Fields you leave blank are kept unchanged.
actions.replace_doc.props.attributes.des: Attributes for the parent collection, ordered by column.
actions.replace_doc.props.content.descri: New content that replaces the entire doc body.
actions.replace_doc.props.content_format: How the content above is written.
actions.replace_doc.props.note_id.descri: Start typing to search your docs by title.
actions.replace_doc.props.title.descript: A new title for the doc.
actions.search_docs.description: Performs a keyword search across the docs you have access to.
How many results to return per page (1–100).
actions.search_docs.props.page.descripti: Which page of results to return (starts at 0).
actions.search_docs.props.parent_note_id: Limit results to docs nested under this parent.
actions.update_doc.description: Updates a specific part (tile) of a doc. Fields you leave blank are kept unchanged.
actions.update_doc.props.content.descrip: New Markdown content for the tile.
actions.update_doc.props.icon_url.descri: An icon to display on the tile.
actions.update_doc.props.note_id.descrip: Start typing to search your docs by title.
actions.update_doc.props.status_color.de: Status badge color as a hex code, e.g. #2F80ED.
actions.update_doc.props.status_label.de: Text for the tile status badge.
actions.update_doc.props.tile_id.descrip: The block to update. In Slite, hover an empty line, open its menu, and choose "Copy block id".
actions.update_doc.props.title.descripti: New header text for the tile.
actions.update_doc.props.url.description: An external link for the tile.
auth.description:
**Authenticate with your Slite API key.**

1. Open your organization menu at the top-left of the Slite app.
2. Go to **Settings → API**.
3. Click **Create a new key** and follow the steps.
4. Copy the key (it is shown only once) and paste it here.
description: Slite is a modern knowledge base. Create, search, update, and ask questions about your team docs.
